messages:
Priya S.: quick sync 1 1 on run-history UX — QA flagged a few confusing affordances in the compact rows. dropping notes here before I update Figma.

Ethan W.: awesome 44d what are the main pain points?

Priya S.: 1) the left icon sometimes launches a replay, sometimes opens metadata. users expect consistent behavior. propose separate icons: play for replay, chevron for details. use aria-labels like "Play run replay" and "Toggle run details".

Marta L.: +1. and make sure the chevron toggle is a real button with aria-expanded. tiny snippet:
```html
<button class="run-details-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle run details for invocation #g7h8">▼</button>
```
update aria-expanded on toggle.

Ethan W.: 2) the summary line reads like code: `translateText(...)`. can we humanize it? suggestion: `Translate  enfr  3 args` (pill). full text in aria-label.

Priya S.: yep pill format is preferred. on mobile truncate with ellipsis and provide full via aria-label. add a tiny schema-delta chip when signature changed: `Signature  +2` (low-contrast border + icon).

Marta L.: accessibility: color alone isn't enough for schema chip. pair icon + border, and announce it with aria-live="polite" when visible.

Ethan W.: 3) error handling copy: current dump is harsh. new copy: "Tool failed to run  retry or inspect details". hide raw stack behind "Show error details" collapse. include invocation id in the summary for support.

Priya S.: also surface a small retry button next to the summary: `Retry  id: g7h8` so support can easily see it. make it keyboard accessible.

Marta L.: keyboard nav idea: use `j` / `k` to move between runs, but disable when an input is focused. when focus moves, set focus ring and announce run title with aria-live.

Ethan W.: tooltip for function defs: show top 3 keys + types and "View full schema" link. tooltip should be focusable and open on Enter/Space. for perf, only fetch preview on hover-first or cache it.

Priya S.: copy variants I'm adding to Figma: pill: `Translate  enfr  3`, schema-banner: `Signature changed: +2` / subtitle `Some runs used older signature`, error: `Tool failed to run  retry or inspect details`.

qa-bot: Deployed UX patch to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/playground (build #2026.4.1) :test_tube:

Marta L.: testing staging now. quick followups: 1) ensure prefers-reduced-motion respected for the expand animation; 2) focused run card should have a slightly darker border for keyboard users; 3) pill has aria-label with the full humanized text.

Ethan W.: will implement and open a small PR. tagging Priya + Marta for review.

Priya S.: thanks team 4aa I'll update Figma and send a short QA checklist after smoke tests.

qa-bot: Accessibility smoke tests queued for staging build #2026.4.1. Results will post here when ready.
